projects.name: World of Booth
projects.desc: A browser-based 3D exploration game where players walk or drive through a small stylized city to discover three themed photobooths — Downtown, Fountain Studio, and Neon Transit — each with its own filters, frames, and pose prompts. Built with React Three Fiber and Three.js, the world uses a BVH-accelerated collision system for player, vehicle, and camera-occlusion physics, with Meshopt-compressed runtime models for fast loading. Every photo session runs entirely in-canvas: webcam frames are processed client-side into downloadable photostrips and stored locally via IndexedDB, with a discovery/collection loop, character switching, and full desktop/touch controls — no backend, no account, no automatic uploads.
projects.title: World of Booth
projects.subtitle: Take the scenic route.
projects.summary: A small 3D city with a reason to explore. Walk, drive, and find photobooths that turn your webcam into a memory.

projects.name: DUZZ — Analog Camera Lab
projects.desc: A mobile-first browser camera lab that reimagines the analog/instant photography experience. Eighteen original film recipes across Film, Instant, Mono, CCD, and Lab families are rendered through a custom Canvas 2D pipeline covering exposure, grain, halation, light leaks, dust, vignette, and date stamps. Photos save locally as IndexedDB blobs first, then optionally back up to a private Supabase bucket under anonymous-auth RLS with a 12-month retention cron and a rate-limited admin recovery flow for lost photos. The app installs as a PWA with an offline shell, ships full SEO/PWA metadata, and is deployed in production with Google Search Console indexing already verified.
projects.title: DUZZ
projects.subtitle: A pocket-sized darkroom.
projects.summary: An analog camera lab in your browser. Eighteen film recipes, a custom image pipeline, and photos that stay yours.

projects.name: Magic Pin Trading Ecosystem
projects.desc: A massive, multi-repo digital ecosystem for Disney pin collectors and traders. Features an Android & iOS mobile app with AI-powered multi-scan capabilities (using PyTorch and Mask2Former for segmenting pin boards and removing backgrounds), a real-time messaging microservice built on Socket.io, and a custom interactive map engine using GDAL and Leaflet to render high-resolution Disneyland/Disney World map tiles. The web dashboard (React + Tailwind) allows admins to curate the pin catalog, approve trades, manage subscription tiers via PayPal, and view real-time platform analytics.
projects.title: Magic Pin
projects.subtitle: Made for the collectors.
projects.summary: A connected world for pin collectors. Mobile scanning, custom park maps, trading, and a shared collection.

projects.name: SpekHP Specs Portal
projects.desc: A GSMArena-style phone specifications portal designed for the Indonesian market. Built on Leaf MVC v4 (PHP 8.2+) with Eloquent ORM, this custom CMS features AJAX-powered autocomplete search, a dual-device specifications comparison engine, and a fully automated web scraper for GSMArena. The dashboard empowers administrators to manage devices, ad slots, and SEO metadata. Optimized for monetization and discoverability with Adsense slots, automated sitemaps, JSON-LD schema, and an integrated WordPress blog structure via .htaccess.
